doc.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: New York 1948: Tristano and the Miles nonet
title: Chronology of the nonet gigs and recording sessions
summary: They sort out the Royal Roost weeks against the three recording dates and note Miles's heroin addiction.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: We’re back. You remember doing one week at the Royal Roost with the nonet and one week with the quintet and that’s it?
Then the band got the three record dates?
I don’t remember that chronology. I didn’t know if it was before or after.
According to everything I’ve ever read and seen, the Royal Roost was September forty-eight, and then the three recording sessions were January and April of forty-nine and March of nineteen fifty.
And not another gig came out of that, isn’t that strange?
Except the one night at Birdland. That’s all.
That’s kind of strange because we usually followed it up with the release of a record but I guess Miles was into his own other thing by then.
Including being addicted to heroin by that point.
